description: Servicio de visualización WMS de sismicidad is a dataset listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geoserveis.icgc.cat. WMS service for visualization of seismical information until 2019. Coverage: ES. The portal shows the English title as "WMS view service of seismicity" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. The listing shows 2021-05-12 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.icgc.cat/condicions). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
